pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word means "parents"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eltern
   B. die Tanten
   C. die Kinder
   D. die Geschwister

2. What does "das Lied" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. cake
   C. candle
   D. birthday

3. What does "das Abendessen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. watermelon
   C. onion
   D. supper

4. What does "die Zwiebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. egg
   C. fish
   D. onion

5. What does "der Rücken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. back
   B. toe
   C. ear
   D. finger

6. Which song teaches "Kopf, Schulter, Knie und Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. A song about the weather
   B. The action song about body parts
   C. A song about days
   D. A birthday song

7. Which little word goes with the noun "Tochter"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

8. What does "jung" mean? (1 mark)
   A. young
   B. small
   C. old
   D. tall

9. What does "das Zimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fork
   B. table
   C. room
   D. fridge

10. What does "der Schrank" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bedroom
   B. door
   C. cupboard or wardrobe
   D. sofa

11. What does "die Toilette" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bedroom
   B. shower
   C. lamp
   D. toilet

12. What is the plural of "der Freund"? (1 mark)
   A. die Freunds
   B. die Freunden
   C. die Freunder
   D. die Freunde

13. Which German word means "today"? (time) (1 mark)
   A. morgen
   B. heute
   C. jetzt
   D. gestern

14. How many German days of the week end in -tag? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 6

15. Which German word is the number 20? (1 mark)
   A. zwanzig
   B. achtzehn
   C. drei
   D. zwölf

16. Which German word is the number 8? (1 mark)
   A. fünf
   B. dreizehn
   C. vierzehn
   D. acht

17. Which month comes right after "Juli"? (1 mark)
   A. Oktober
   B. August
   C. Mai
   D. Dezember

18. What does "der Kakao" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cocoa
   B. cheese
   C. watermelon
   D. mango

19. Which little word goes with the noun "Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

20. What does "das Gesicht" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. face
   C. head
   D. back

21. What is the plural of "die Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. die Muttere
   B. die Mutters
   C. die Mütter
   D. die Mutteren

22. Which German word means "tall or big"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. jung
   B. lustig
   C. groß
   D. nett

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

24. Which German word or phrase means "fork"? (1 mark)
   A. das Zimmer
   B. die Küche
   C. das Wohnzimmer
   D. die Gabel

25. Which German word or phrase means "chair"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. die Küche
   C. das Radio
   D. das Sofa

26. Which day has a double t in the middle? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Samstag
   D. Montag

27. Which little word goes with the noun "Party"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

28. Which German word means "November"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Mai
   B. November
   C. März
   D. September

29. Which food group does "die Karotte" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Gemüse
   D. die Getränke

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. den
   D. das

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

35. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

37. Write a short weather report in German with a greeting, weather and a goodbye. (4 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: candle, sky, cooker, knife. (4 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

40. Write the German names of these months: July, August, September. (3 marks)

41. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)

42. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)

44. Match the body part to what it does: Auge, Ohr, Nase. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

46. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

47. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — die Eltern
   Eltern are the mother and father together.

2. A — song
   das Lied means song.

3. D — supper
   das Abendessen means supper.

4. D — onion
   die Zwiebel means onion.

5. A — back
   der Rücken means back.

6. B — The action song about body parts
   The song names head, shoulders, knees and feet.

7. C — die
   It is die Tochter, so the little word is die.

8. A — young
   jung is the opposite of alt.

9. C — room
   das Zimmer means room.

10. C — cupboard or wardrobe
   der Schrank means cupboard or wardrobe.

11. D — toilet
   die Toilette means toilet.

12. D — die Freunde
   The plural of der Freund is die Freunde.

13. B — heute
   today in German is heute.

14. D — 6
   Montag, Dienstag, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag and Sonntag. Only Mittwoch does not.

15. A — zwanzig
   20 in German is zwanzig.

16. D — acht
   8 in German is acht.

17. B — August
   After Juli comes August.

18. A — cocoa
   der Kakao means cocoa.

19. A — das
   It is das Brot, so the little word is das.

20. B — face
   das Gesicht means face.

21. C — die Mütter
   The plural of die Mutter is die Mütter.

22. C — groß
   tall or big in German is groß.

23. C — das
   It is das Zimmer, so the little word is das.

24. D — die Gabel
   fork in German is die Gabel.

25. A — der Stuhl
   chair in German is der Stuhl.

26. B — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch is spelled with tt.

27. B — die
   It is die Party, so the little word is die.

28. B — November
   November in German is November.

29. C — das Gemüse
   die Karotte belongs to das Gemüse.

30. A — die
   It is die Nase, so the little word is die.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

32. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen! Heute ist es sonnig und warm. Es ist nicht windig. Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for weather sentences, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for the goodbye.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Kerze, der Himmel, der Herd, das Messer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Juli, August, September.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

43. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Auge = sehen, Ohr = hören, Nase = riechen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.
